thread:
Maria (release-lead): OK team — this is the quiet-window release for py/ts SDKs. Preparing to flip disttag at 02:00 UTC. Can we do final preflight now?
aj: starting preflight checks now. I'll run checksum + signer validation against the release artifacts.
CI-bot: preflight job triggered: `ci/preflight-sdk-release #7821`
DeployBot: scheduled publish job queued for 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Use `--hold` to cancel.
Samir (pkg-maintainer): I see a signer drift alert on the 3rd-party wheel mirror during local verification — signature mismatch on `sdk_python-3.4.1-py3-none-any.whl`.
aj: hmm, I got the same locally. Checksum is fine but `gpg --verify` fails. Not from our signing key.
Maria (release-lead): OK do not flip disttag yet. Samir, can you run a quick bisect to confirm which step introduced the mismatched artifact?
Samir (pkg-maintainer): running `republish --verify --staging` to reupload artifacts from build cache and compare. If mismatch persists, we'll roll back the public publish and use signed fallback wheels.
Kate (docs): Heads-up — if we hold, I'll delay the release notes publish and add a short note about the signer investigation.
aj: logs from `republish --verify` snippet:
```
Uploading sdk_python-3.4.1... OK
verifying signature... FAILED (sig 0xA1B2C3D4 not trusted)
checksum: a1b2c3... matches
```
Samir (pkg-maintainer): Good catch — looks like the wheel on mirror lost the gpg signature blob during CDN edge replication. Local artifact is signed correctly in build cache.
Maria (release-lead): Plan: 1) Pause DeployBot publish (hold). 2) Samir to repush signed wheel to staging and force re-checksum on CDN. 3) aj to run an end-to-end smoke: install from the staging URL and run `sdk.tests.quick_smoke`. 4) If green, do a controlled flip with DeployBot using `--force-signed`. 5) If not green within 30m, fallback: revert disttag, announce rollback, and open a release re-upload ticket.
aj: implementing step 1 now — DeployBot, set hold.
DeployBot: publish job status updated: HELD by @aj at 2026-03-22T01:25:10Z :white_check_mark:
Samir (pkg-maintainer): repush started. Using build-cache commit `b3f7c2d`. Will also trigger CDN invalidation.
CI-bot: triggered smoke job `ci/smoke-staging #7822` after repush.
Kate (docs): Drafted a small ephemeral note for release-notes: "Release delayed for signer verification. Will update when resolved." Putting in `docs/release/drafts/`
aj: smoke job shows `sdk.tests.quick_smoke` infra fail earlier but that's unrelated — retrying after repush.
Samir (pkg-maintainer): repush complete, CDN purge submitted: `cdnctl purge --path /pkgs/sdk_python-3.4.1*`
CI-bot: smoke job result: PASSED ✅ (installed from staging URL, basic auth/compat tests ok)
Maria (release-lead): Great. Ready to flip with force-signed — but let's do a one-time canary: route 5% of requests for 10 minutes to the new disttag. DeployBot, please run `publish --disttag next --canary 5% --signed-only` and hold the final flip until health metrics look good.
DeployBot: command queued by @Maria: `publish --disttag next --canary 5% --signed-only --meta "py/ts SDK quiet-window canary"` — starting canary now.
aj: monitoring metrics: token requests, pypi download counts, client telemetry. Setting alert to ping this thread if error rate > 1%.
Samir (pkg-maintainer): added rollback script to ops: `scripts/quick_revert_disttag.sh` in case we need instant revert.
DeployBot: canary running. Current canary error rate: 0.0% (0/142).
Kate (docs): Updated release note draft: added a line about canary and signer fix.
Maria (release-lead): If error rate stays <1% for 10m, we'll proceed to full flip. If it spikes, we revert immediately and escalate. Everyone please thumbs-up when watching. :eyes:
aj: :thumbsup:
Samir (pkg-maintainer): :thumbsup:
Kate (docs): :thumbsup:
Maria (release-lead): Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the rollout/rollback decision. I'll post the final flip or rollback here.
(10 minutes later)
DeployBot: canary complete: success metrics within threshold. Canary duration: 10m. Error rate: 0.0%.
Maria (release-lead): Proceeding to full flip. DeployBot, run final publish with `--force-signed` and tag release notes.
DeployBot: publish job started: `publish --disttag latest --force-signed --meta "py/ts SDK release 3.4.1"`
CI-bot: publish completed, index updated, mirrors notified.
Samir (pkg-maintainer): Verified signed wheels on mirror and checksums post-flip — good.

Maria (release-lead): Closing thread — release successful. Follow-up: create a postmortem ticket to investigate CDN signature strip and add an automated signing verification step in the final publish job (fail-fast).

Maria (release-lead): Thanks all. :rocket:
